description: The best people for one vacancy: pass job_id or job_url of an Alion vacancy, or describe it (role, technology as a comma list, country / can_work_in, work_mode, seniority, budget_usd). The role and the place are hard filters; the technologies rank the people by how many of them they have, and each row says which (why). Use it when you hire for a concrete role; search_people when you browse. Free; limits by trust: no account 50 profile reads and 20 searches a day per network, a wallet signed in with SIWX 100 and 50, an Alion account 1,000 and 200, a verified company 5,000 and 1,000. Docs: https://alion.io/developers/docs

active_within_days.description: Only people active on Alion in this many days.

availability.description: actively_looking only, or everyone open to offers (the default).

budget_usd.description: The most the role pays a year in USD: people who expect more are left out.

can_work_in.description: A country the person may work in (lives there, holds a permit or citizenship): ISO code.

company.description: Worked (or works) at this company: name or domain.

country.description: Where the person lives: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous page (a search does not page past row 100).

employment_type.description: A kind of work the person takes.

has_github.description: Only people with their GitHub on the profile.

languages.description: Spoken languages, a comma list ("German, French"); all required.

min_years.description: Years with each named technology (or in total when none is named).

query.description: Free words over titles, summaries, employers and skills ("computer vision drones").

role.description: Role family or specialisation, e.g. "Backend", "Data Engineer", "Product Manager" (alion://dictionaries/role-families).

seniority.description: One or a comma list: intern, junior, middle, senior, staff, principal, lead, head, architect.

sort.description: best_match (default), recent_activity (last active first) or experience (most years first).

technology.description: Technologies the person must have, a comma list ("Python, PostgreSQL"); every one is required.

work_mode.description: A work mode the person accepts.

name: match_people

person.description: The handle: pass it to get_person, check_fit or send_message.

why.description: The facts behind the row's place.

meta.description: Quota and credit standing after this call.

billing.description: live (charged), free_daily (a compact read of the daily allowance), preview (metered, not charged yet), staff, partner or free

credits_left.description: The account balance after this call, in credits.

free_reads_left_today.description: Compact reads still free today for an assistant connected through OAuth (Claude, ChatGPT)

tier.description: anonymous, free, pro, partner or staff

next_cursor.description: Pass back as cursor, other arguments unchanged.

total_estimate.description: A count, or "<n>+" past the pool.

vacancy.description: match_people: the vacancy as it was read.

title: Match people to a vacancy
